xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The Standalone and Consolidated financial results of the company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 were reviewed by the Audit committee and approved by the Board of Directors in their respective meetings held on October 28, 2026. The Statutory Auditors have carried out limited review of the same and expressed an unmodified review report on these financial results.

2. The Statement has been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) notified under section133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 and other relevant provisions of the Act.

3. The Company has incorporated the Control Print ESOP Trust in accordance with the Control Print Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025. The ESOP trust buys share of the Company from the market, for giving shares to eligible employees. The Shares held by ESOP trust are treated as treasury shares and recognised at cost in the books of ESOP Trust and upon consolidation the same is deducted from Other Equity. The company have not granted any stock options to the employees under this Scheme till date. Accordingly, no expense in respect of stock-based compensation has been recognised in the books of account. Stock Option whenever exercised, would be satisfied with treasury shares.

4. The Company has entered into an Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement with CP Italy S.R.L, a step-down wholly owned subsidiary on 08-May-2026, for the purchase of its Intellectual Property Rights, including patents for a total consideration of INR 3,120.11 Lakhs (Equivalent to EURO 28.60 Lakhs). Accordingly, as on quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company has recorded Rs. 3,120.11 Lakhs as Intangible Assets under development.

5. The amount of Rs. 399.03 Lakhs (Credit) for the half year ended September 30, 2025, represents a grant received under the Central Capital Investment Incentive for Access to Credit (CCIIAC) from Directorate of Industries, Government of Himachal Pradesh. This item does not appear in the financial results related to Half Year Ended 30th September, 2026 being a one-time occurrence and accordingly not directly comparable.

6. The Company has single reportable segment namely Coding & Marking Applications for the Purpose of Ind AS on segment reporting.

7. Previous period/year’s figure have been regrouped and/or rearranged whenever considered necessary to confirm to current period/year’s classification.
